paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc is currently 1.62, representing a 2.87 percent increase from the prior close, but a 52.92 percent decrease over the last 22 trading sessions. There has been one new news item in the last 24 hours.

Recent news headlines include a report from Stocktwits that the largest shareholder of Fermi Inc has renewed calls for a sale or strategic partnership of the company. This news item was posted on November 9, 2026, and mentions that Toby Neugebauer, co-founder and largest shareholder, made this push after an 80 percent rout.

There have been various SEC filings recently, including a Form 4 filing on November 6, 2026, and multiple Form 144 filings on November 5, 4, and 3, 2026, indicating insider transactions and proposed sales of restricted shares. Additionally, there was an 8-K filing on November 4, 2026, disclosing the results of Fermi Inc's 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders.
